data.one_liner: Download videos and audio from 1000+ websites using yt-dlp.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that downloads videos and audio from over 1,000 websites using yt-dlp and native Android implementations. It provides real-time progress tracking, format selection, audio extraction, subtitle support, and playlist management.
use_when: You need to download videos or extract audio from YouTube and 1000+ other supported websites in a Flutter app.
You require granular format selection, quality presets, and metadata/thumbnail embedding on Android.
avoid_when: Your application targets iOS, as iOS support is not currently implemented.
You only need standard video playback rather than downloading and processing media files.
strengths: Supports downloading from over 1,000 websites via yt-dlp.
Comprehensive feature set including audio extraction, subtitles, playlists, and Aria2c integration.
Stream-based progress tracking and type-safe communication via Pigeon.
weaknesses: Requires specific native Android configuration such as minimum SDK 24 and extractNativeLibs.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum SDK to 24+ and extractNativeLibs=true in AndroidManifest.xml.
